responsibilities: Design, develop, maintain, and optimize SAP BW 7.x/BW4HANA solutions, including InfoProviders (DSOs, InfoCubes, CompositeProviders), transformations, DTPs, process chains, Open Hub destinations, and BEx Queries.
Develop and support SAP BusinessObjects solutions, including IDT universes, WebI reports, CMC administration, and report scheduling, ensuring accurate, reliable, and efficient reporting.

Design and maintain SAP BW integrations with SAP S/4HANA, including ODP, CDS View extraction, source system connectivity, RFC configuration, DataSource replication, delta load management, and ODQMON monitoring.
Apply knowledge of the S/4HANA data model, including ACDOCA and the Universal Journal, to support financial and operational reporting requirements.
Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications, data models, and scalable solutions aligned with business objectives and enterprise data architecture.
Lead technical analysis, performance optimization, and root cause resolution for complex data extraction, transformation, integration, reporting, and production support issues.
Manage assigned solutions throughout the development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing maintenance.
Establish and promote technical standards, documentation practices, data quality controls, and testing procedures to improve system reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

Collaborate with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams, including Security and Basis, to deliver reporting solutions, resolve technical dependencies, and support appropriate user access.
Identify opportunities to automate processes, improve data integrity, and enhance existing systems; evaluate emerging SAP analytics technologies and recommend improvements as appropriate.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: data quality controls, and testing procedures to improve system reliability
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals ("data quality controls, and testing procedures", "accurate, reliable, and efficient reporting", "improve data integrity") outweigh one "fast-paced environment" in the skills list.
evidence.domain_risk: to support financial and operational reporting requirements
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role builds reporting on the S/4HANA general ledger (ACDOCA, Universal Journal) "to support financial and operational reporting requirements", which is explicit financial reporting language.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named SAP BW and BusinessObjects estates already run and the role will "enhance existing systems", so an established but not specialised data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: InfoProviders (DSOs, InfoCubes, CompositeProviders), transformations, DTPs, process chains, Open Hub destinations, and BEx Queries
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name exact SAP objects and transactions ("DTPs, process chains, Open Hub destinations", "ODQMON monitoring"), so a hiring manager wrote them.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: ACDOCA and the Universal Journal, to support financial and operational reporting requirements
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The only named business audience is financial reporting built on the ledger tables ("ACDOCA and the Universal Journal"); the rest is BI platform work for business stakeholders.
evidence.autonomy_level: Lead technical analysis... Establish and promote technical standards
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns technical standards and leads troubleshooting ("Establish and promote technical standards") while delivering reporting for the business, so mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tools or AI-facing data work appear in the posting.
evidence.testing_framing: Establish and promote technical standards, documentation practices, data quality controls, and testing procedures
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality controls and testing procedures are something the candidate establishes, so responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: root cause resolution for complex data extraction, transformation, integration, reporting, and production support issues
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The fear is production failures and unreliable reporting, framed as operational reliability rather than compliance, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: improve data integrity, and enhance existing systems
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The work maintains, optimises and extends an existing SAP BW and BusinessObjects estate.
evidence.language_gate: Ability to effectively communicate in English, both verbally and in writing. Additional languages preferred.
evidence.loss_aversion: Lead technical analysis, performance optimization, and root cause resolution for complex data extraction, transformation, integration, reporting, and production support issues.
